title: Log Scrub Contract
user: Security-conscious developers forwarding structured logs who need regression-tested proof that configured secrets and personal data are removed before a drain or support bundle leaves their environment.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI with JSON/text fixture tests, path/regex/token rules, entropy checks, and a redacted before/after report that can gate CI.
constraints: Never upload fixtures; avoid reversible masking by default; make regex performance safe; warn that redaction rules are not a compliance certification.
